discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch. Replaced the anchor with a native `<button type="button">` styled as a link, so Enter/Space activation comes for free; the test now asserts the element is a real button.

Addressed in 229051e. Rather than a scrolling strip (which would clip the attached-tab effect), tabs now shrink and truncate their labels, so + and the hide button stay reachable regardless of tab count.

I think this is reading the pre-229051e code: the tab wrapper is min-w-0 (not shrink-0) and the label is min-w-0 truncate, so tabs shrink rather than overflow. Verified in the running app with 10 tabs open: labels truncate with an ellipsis and both + and the hide button remain fully visible and clickable. I kept shrink-to-fit over a scrolling strip because overflow clipping would cut the active tab's join to the panel body.
